comment: User must verify all values against the adopted NEC edition, installation conditions, conductor listing, and terminal ratings. This seed is not an independent code certification.

source.reference: NFPA 70 (NEC), 2023 edition, Table 402.5; supplied implementation plan §4.1.

applicationNote: 6 A for #18 and 8 A for #16 are the user-requested conservative fallback for Class 2 cable with no manufacturer ampacity. Table 402.5 governs fixture wire; this fallback does not confer a listing or replace the cable manufacturer rating.
